module autovcoder_089661 (  /*AUTOARG*/
    // Outputs
    y,
    // Inputs
    a,
    b,
    rstn
);
  input [1:0] a;
  input [1:0] b;
  input rstn;

  output [1:0] y;

  // d.f : 0
  // d.t : 1

  wire wc00, wc01, c10, c11;

  /*AUTOINPUT*/
  /*AUTOOUTPUT*/
  /*AUTOWIRE*/

  cmuller C00 (
      .rstn(rstn),
      .a(a[0]),
      .b(b[0]),
      .c(wc00)
  );


  cmuller C01 (
      .rstn(rstn),
      .a(a[1]),
      .b(b[0]),
      .c(wc01)
  );

  cmuller C10 (
      .rstn(rstn),
      .a(a[0]),
      .b(b[1]),
      .c(wc10)
  );
  cmuller C11 (
      .rstn(rstn),
      .a(a[1]),
      .b(b[1]),
      .c(wc11)
  );

  assign y[0] = wc00 | wc01 | wc10;
  assign y[1] = wc11;


endmodule
